description: Add a client-side 'Model accuracy' page that visualizes the backtest results (hit rate, Brier score, calibration) with an accuracy-slider comparison, localized EN/JA with in-UI metric definitions, plus matching documentation in the specs and both READMEs. This satisfies Issue #16 acceptance criterion (2) metric definitions explained in UI and README, and completes the UI/visualization proposal. Design decision (document it): the SPA computes metrics CLIENT-SIDE by importing the pure @mlb/shared backtest engine and the bundled seed brackets directly — no new backend endpoint and no infra change, which keeps it infra-free and fully deterministic. Bedrock is never involved (criterion 3) because the engine imports only pure shared code and seed JSON.
steps: Add new i18n MessageKeys to frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (extend the MessageKey union AND provide BOTH en and ja strings for each). Suggested keys: 'accuracy.nav', 'accuracy.pageTitle', 'accuracy.intro', 'accuracy.region', 'accuracy.metric.hitRate', 'accuracy.metric.hitRate.def', 'accuracy.metric.brier', 'accuracy.metric.brier.def', 'accuracy.metric.calibration', 'accuracy.metric.calibration.def', 'accuracy.table.accuracy', 'accuracy.table.sampleCount', 'accuracy.table.season', 'accuracy.season.combined', 'accuracy.calibration.bucket', 'accuracy.calibration.predicted', 'accuracy.calibration.empirical', 'accuracy.calibration.count', 'accuracy.sliderCompareTitle', 'accuracy.backToBracket', 'accuracy.methodology'. Write concise, accurate JA + EN copy. The Brier definition must state it is the mean squared error between the predicted probability of the eventual series winner and 1 (lower is better, range 0..1). The calibration definition must state it groups predictions into probability buckets and compares the mean predicted probability to the actual win rate in that bucket.

Create frontend/src/pages/AccuracyPage.tsx. Import runMultiSeasonBacktest and runBacktestAcrossAccuracies (and types) from '@mlb/shared', and useI18n/teamName from '../i18n'. Compute metrics in a useMemo over a fixed accuracy list [0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1] (reuse the shared ACCURACY values; the comparison must be deterministic). Render: (1) a page heading and localized intro; (2) a 'metric definitions' section rendering the localized hitRate/brier/calibration definitions (criterion 2); (3) a comparison table or styled bars showing hitRate and brierScore for each accuracy value across 2024, 2025, and combined; (4) a calibration display for a default accuracy (0.5): per-bucket bars (simple SVG or CSS-styled divs) showing predictedCount, meanPredictedProbability, and empiricalWinRate, with accessible text (e.g. a visually-hidden or caption summary and aria-labels) so it is not purely visual. Use a region landmark with aria-label t('accuracy.region'). Guard against empty buckets (render count 0 gracefully).
Register the route in frontend/src/App.tsx: add `<Route path="/accuracy" element={<AccuracyPage />} />` and import AccuracyPage. Keep the existing redirect/catch-all behavior.

Add a visible, localized link to the accuracy page from the main UI so e2e can navigate to it: e.g. in frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx add a nav link (react-router <Link to="/accuracy"> or navigate) labeled with t('accuracy.nav'). Ensure it is reachable in results-only seasons too (the backtest is about completed 2024/2025).

Add/extend unit tests: a frontend component test for AccuracyPage (e.g. frontend/src/pages/AccuracyPage.test.tsx using the existing @testing-library/react + I18nProvider pattern seen in HomePage.test.tsx) asserting the hit-rate, Brier, and calibration sections render and that the Brier/calibration definition text appears. Keep it deterministic (the shared engine is deterministic).

Add a Playwright e2e spec frontend/e2e/accuracy.spec.ts following the home.spec.ts pattern: navigate to /accuracy (or click the nav link from '/'), assert the page shows the hit rate, Brier score, and calibration sections and the metric explanation text, in the default JA language and at least once in EN via the language toggle. Assert the accuracy comparison (multiple accuracy values) is present. Capture a screenshot to test-results/.

Update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md to add the backtest/model-accuracy feature: requirements (deterministic seed-only backtest, metric definitions in UI+README, no Bedrock), design (pure shared engine, 'predict at end of game k' semantics, Brier + calibration definitions, client-side computation choice and why), and tasks (mark the implementation). Keep the specs truthful to what was built.

Update README.md and README.ja.md: add a 'Model accuracy / backtest' section explaining the feature, the exact Brier score definition (mean squared error between predicted probability of the eventual winner and 1; 0 is perfect, lower is better), the calibration definition (probability-bucket mean-predicted vs empirical win rate), the deterministic seed-only guarantee, and that Bedrock is NOT called. Mirror the content in both languages.
Run frontend unit tests, the full `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run synth`, and the e2e suite (install chromium first if needed with `npx playwright install chromium`).
acceptance_criteria: A /accuracy route renders a Model accuracy page showing hit rate, Brier score, and a calibration display, with an accuracy-value comparison across [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1]
The page shows localized (EN + JA) definitions of Brier score and calibration (criterion 2), and the same definitions appear in README.md and README.ja.md
The page computes metrics client-side via the @mlb/shared backtest engine + seed brackets (no new backend endpoint, no infra change)
A frontend unit test and a Playwright e2e spec assert the page renders the three metrics and the metric explanations
.kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md and both READMEs document the feature and metric definitions
`npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run synth`, and `npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend` all pass
findings: Implemented on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site. Added a client-side /accuracy page (frontend/src/pages/AccuracyPage.tsx) that computes metrics in a useMemo via the pure @mlb/shared engine (runBacktestAcrossAccuracies over [0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1] + runMultiSeasonBacktest(0.5) for calibration) over the bundled 2024/2025 seed brackets. NO new backend endpoint and NO infra change (documented in design.md). Page renders: a region landmark (aria-label accuracy.region), localized metric definitions (hit rate / Brier / calibration), a comparison table of hitRate+Brier for 2024/2025/combined across the 5 accuracies (table caption + testids hitRate-/brier-<acc>-<slice>), and an accessible 5-bucket calibration display (CSS bars + per-row aria-labels via accuracy.calibration.binLabel + caption summary). Added 34 new i18n MessageKeys (accuracy.*) with BOTH en + ja strings including the Brier definition (mean squared error between predicted probability of eventual winner and 1; 0..1, lower better, 0 perfect) and the calibration definition (groups predictions into probability buckets, compares mean predicted probability to actual win rate). Registered <Route path="/accuracy"> in App.tsx BEFORE the catch-all; added a visible localized header nav Link (accuracy.nav) in HomePage.tsx reachable in every season. Added CSS to styles.css. Tests: frontend/src/pages/AccuracyPage.test.tsx (5 tests, asserts the 3 metric sections, the Brier+calibration definition text, pinned combined 0.5 hitRate 82.2%/brier 0.166 and per-season 90.7%/74.5%, accuracy=0 brier 0.250, 5 calibration buckets with aria-labels, JA localization) and frontend/e2e/accuracy.spec.ts (2 tests: nav from bracket, 3 metrics + explanations in JA then EN via toggle, multi-accuracy comparison present, screenshot to test-results/accuracy-page.png). Docs: updated .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md and both README.md + README.ja.md with a 'Model accuracy / backtest' section (exact Brier + calibration definitions, deterministic seed-only guarantee, Bedrock NOT called, client-side-computation rationale, predict moved to shared). VERIFICATION all green: npm run build, npm test (shared 34, backend 92, frontend 62, infra 8), npm run synth, and npm run test:e2e -w @mlb/frontend (24 e2e passed incl. the 2 new accuracy specs). NOTE: shared/src/integrity.property.test.ts (a fast-check property test with a random seed, UNRELATED to this change and untouched by it) failed once intermittently then passed on all reruns; it is a pre-existing flaky test, not caused by this feature. Commit: see git log. Did NOT push or open a PR.
